buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) 1. The detailed terms, eligibility, technical evaluation criteria, scope of work and contract conditions are g iven in the Buyer uploaded ATC document (RFP No. PROJ-201/224/2026-SUDA (T M P F) SECTION / 434 244-11 dated 02/11/2026). Bidders shall read it in full before bidding. 2. Scope of work: Bid Process Management and Project Development and Management Consultancy (P DMC) for AHP projects under PMAY-U 2.0 in the ULBs of Chhattisgarh, presently 6 ULBs, 13,361 houses and Rs 768.26 Cr of approved projects, plus AHP houses sanctioned hereafter (Clause 3.1), for 36 mon ths, as per Section 7 (Terms of Reference and Scope of Work) of the RFP. 3. Eligibility: as per Clause 3.12.2 of the RFP, including: legal entity in existence in India for at least 7 y ears as on 31/03/2026; experience of similar assignments in the last 7 years of minimum 3 projects of civil construction cost not less than Rs 308 Cr each, or 2 projects not less than Rs 385 Cr each, or 1 pro ject not less than Rs 615 Cr; average annual turnover from consulting services of at least Rs 8 Cr in an y 3 of the last 5 audited financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26); and positive net worth in any 3 of those 5 years. Bidders shall upload all supporting documents (certificate of incorporation, GST, PAN, work or ders / agreements, client completion certificates, audited financial statements / CA certificate) along w ith the technical bid. 4. Bidders shall upload RFP Forms 1 to 12, 14 to 20, 23 and 24, the Form-1 Financial Covering Letter (wit hout price), CVs of the four Key Professionals (Project Manager cum Team Leader, Procurement Expert , Quantity Surveyor, Design Engineer Structural) in RFP Form 20, the Power of Attorney of the signator y (RFP Form 11), and a scanned copy of the EMD, as a signed, page-numbered and indexed PDF (Claus es 3.4, 3.13.2 and 3.13.5.1 of the RFP). 5. Technical evaluation shall be as per Clause 4.5 of the RFP (maximum 100 marks). Only bidders meetin g the eligibility criteria and securing at least 75 marks shall be technically qualified. Financial bids of o nly technically qualified bidders shall be opened on GeM. Selection shall be by Least Cost Selection (L 1) among technically qualified bidders. SUDA may negotiate with the L1 bidder as per Clause 4.6 of the RFP. 6. The price quoted on GeM shall be the total fee for the complete assignment of 36 months, i.e. the Grand Total (A+B) of Form FIN-1 of the RFP, inclusive of all taxes including GST an d all expenses (office, report printing, back-office support, A&OE, local transportation). Co nditional bids shall be rejected. 7. Bidders shall upload the filled Form FIN-1 only under "Financial Document Indicating Price Break-up", and not in the technical bid. In case of mismatch, the price quoted on the GeM portal shall prevail and the man-month rates of Form FIN-1 shall be adjusted proportionall y. 8. The price shall be quoted only on the GeM portal. Any price disclosed in the technical bid s hall lead to rejection of the bid. 9. Payment shall be made as per Clause 7.7 (Payment Schedule and Terms) of the RFP: Part A (DPR prep aration and bid process management) is milestone-linked; Part B (PMC services) is on man-month basi s as per Form FIN-1. 5% retention shall be deducted from running bills and released 12 months after pr

oject completion. KPI-based deductions shall apply as per Clause 7.6. No escalation shall be payable. 10. EMD of Rs 5,00,000 shall be submitted as an FDR / TDR / DD in favour of "Chief Executive Officer, SUD A, Nava Raipur Atal Nagar Chhattisgarh", payable at Raipur, valid for 225 days from the bid due date ( Clause 3.5 of the RFP). Bids without valid EMD shall be rejected, no exemption from EMD shall be provi ded to anyone. 11. Only the original EMD instrument shall be sent by Registered / Speed Post in a sealed envelope, mark ed with the RFP No. and name of work, to CEO, SUDA, Block-D, 4th Floor, Indravati Bhavan (HOD Buildi ng), Nava Raipur Atal Nagar – 492002, to reach by 04/12/2026, 16:00 hrs. Personal delivery shall not b e accepted and no drop box facility is available. All other documents shall be submitted online on GeM only. 12. Technical evaluation shall begin after receipt of the original EMD instruments on 04/12/2026, 16:00 hr s. 13. Joint ventures and consortiums are not allowed (Clause 3.15 of the RFP). The contract or any part of it shall not be sub-let or assigned without prior written consent of CEO, SUDA (Clause 3.17). 14. Conflict of interest, as defined in Clause 3.33 of the RFP, shall lead to disqualification. The selected con sultant and its affiliates shall not be eligible for works related to the construction of the same projects ( Clause 3.33.10). 15. SUDA may call for and verify the originals of any document from the L1 bidder before award. If any do cument is found false or misleading, the bid shall be rejected, the EMD forfeited, and action taken as p er Clauses 3.28 and 3.35 of the RFP. 16. The successful bidder shall submit ePBG / Bank Guarantee of 5% of contract value, valid for the contra ct period plus 6 months, within 30 days of issue of the Letter of Intent, and sign the agreement within 30 days of issue of the LoI / LoA (Clauses 3.30 to 3.32 of the RFP). 17. Replacement of Key Professionals requires prior written approval of SUDA (Clause 7.4) and shall attrac t a penalty of Rs 1,00,000 per replacement for the Project Manager cum Team Leader and Rs 50,000 p er replacement for other resources, increasing for subsequent replacements, as per Clause 7.13 of the RFP. Total penalties shall not exceed 10% of the contract price. 18. Bids shall remain valid for 180 days from the bid end date. 19. Disputes not settled amicably shall be referred to arbitration by a Sole Arbitrator (Principal Secretary / Secretary / Special Secretary, UADD, CG) under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, as per Claus e 9.4 of the General Conditions of Contract in the RFP. 2.
